question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
-- Build the full query
WITH first_payments AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, p.payment_date, p.rental_id
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
        FROM payment
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) first_pay ON p.customer_id = first_pay.customer_id AND p.payment_date = first_pay.first_payment_date
),
first_rentals AS (
    SELECT fp.customer_id, fp.payment_date, fp.rental_id, r.inventory_id
    FROM first_payments fp
    JOIN rental r ON fp.rental_id = r.rental_id
),
first_film_ratings AS (
    SELECT fr.customer_id, fr.payment_date, fr.rental_id, f.rating
    FROM first_rentals fr
    JOIN inventory i ON fr.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rental_counts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as total_rentals
    FROM rental
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_first_rating AS (
    SELECT ffr.customer_id, ffr.rating
    FROM first_film_ratings ffr
)
SELECT 
    cfr.rating,
    AVG(ct.total_amount) as avg_total_amount_spent,
    AVG(crc.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM customer_first_rating cfr
JOIN customer_totals ct ON cfr.customer_id = ct.customer_id
JOIN customer_rental_counts crc ON cfr.customer_id = crc.customer_id
GROUP BY cfr.rating
ORDER BY cfr.rating
